parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const i=$json,b=i.body??i;if(String(i.headers?.['x-webhook-secret']??'')!==$env.QUOTE_WEBHOOK_SECRET)throw new Error('unauthorized');if(!b.sourceEventId||!b.customerId||!b.currency||!Array.isArray(b.items)||!b.items.length)throw new Error('invalid quote request');const idempotencyKey=crypto.createHash('sha256').update('quote:'+b.sourceEventId).digest('hex');return[{json:{...b,idempotencyKey,quoteKey:'Q-'+idempotencyKey.slice(0,16)}}];

WITH q AS(INSERT INTO quotes(quote_key,customer_id,currency,version,status,subtotal_minor,discount_minor,tax_minor,total_minor,valid_until,requested_by)VALUES($12,$1,$2,1,CASE WHEN $9 THEN 'pending_approval' ELSE 'approved' END,$3,$4,$5,$6,now()+make_interval(days=>$7),$8)RETURNING id,quote_key,version),l AS(INSERT INTO quote_lines(quote_id,sku,description,quantity,unit_price_minor,tax_rate_bps)SELECT q.id,x.sku,x.description,x.quantity,x.unit_price_minor,x.tax_rate_bps FROM q,jsonb_to_recordset($10::jsonb)x(sku text,description text,quantity int,unit_price_minor bigint,tax_rate_bps int)),a AS(INSERT INTO approvals(quote_id,quote_version,role,status)SELECT q.id,q.version,role,'pending' FROM q,unnest($11::text[])role)SELECT id,quote_key,version FROM q;
